title: Resourceful
description: Found and picked up at 4 or morer different types of items.

description: Won after beginning with both hands empty.

description: Began with both hands full.

title: Returned Empty-Handed
description: Won with one empty hand.

title: Returned with a Memento
description: Won with both hands full.

description: Won while carrying a brand new item.

title: Sword Master
description: Defeated 3 or more enemies with a sword.

title: Devoted Follower
description: Was resurrected 3 or more times.

description: Unlocked a total of 5 or more locked chests and doors.

description: Use cursed bait to defeat 3 or more enemies.

description: Looked at your map in more than half of the rooms.

description: Stepped on 10 or more bugs.
